name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.wechatminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (WeChat Mini Game)
description:
WeChat Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Implements IOperationClipboardManager over the WeChat clipboard SDK with callback-based read / write, and self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via WechatMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). The platform shows a content-copied toast after a successful write. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的微信小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。基于微信小游戏剪贴板 API 实现回调式读写，由 WechatMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_WECHAT_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。写入成功后平台会弹出内容已复制的系统提示。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
